evd_title: Ours-SciBERT with combined human and LLM knowledge achieved F1=0.83 and accuracy=0.84 on method novelty prediction
finding: Ours-SciBERT with combined human and LLM knowledge achieved F1=0.83 and accuracy=0.84 on method novelty prediction
P: 2,432 ICLR 2022 papers (method sections + reviews), binary method novelty; test ~244
I: Ours-SciBERT: fine-tuned SciBERT + knowledge-guided sparse attention; inputs human review sentences + ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo) summaries
C: 5 fine-tuned PLMs (BERT, RoBERTa, SciBERT, XLNet, ALBERT); zero-shot LLaMA-3.1-8B, ChatGPT, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet
O: Weighted F1 0.83, Acc 0.84 vs SciBERT 0.73, Claude-3.5 0.69, GPT-4o 0.68
